# Garland Tools patch metadata

`patches.json` and `LICENSE` are copied from GarlandTools commit
`04cadd2e1e0de86c20aa9303faa082c7971f8d8b`:

https://github.com/ufx/GarlandTools

The collection catalog generator uses only entries where `type` is `item` and
`patch` is earlier than `4.45`. Newer release metadata comes from the
`ffxiv-datamining-cn` `Item.csv` Git history. Garland Tools is licensed under
the MIT License; the original license is preserved in this directory.
